title: Affordable housing tax exemption and Lodging House By-law
subtitle: Also: parking agreements on King Street West, Stanley Park partnership, account write-offs and a church noise exemption.
overview: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee recommended that Kitchener join the Region of Waterloo's property tax exemption program for affordable housing. Under the recommendation, non-profit and co-operative housing providers would not pay the City's share of the property tax levy for 20 years from 2025. An amendment to extend that to 60 years was lost, and staff will report back after the first full year {{vote:m6}}.

The committee also recommended approving a new Lodging House By-law with its fees, and asking that two full-time staff positions for administration, inspection and enforcement be considered in the 2025 Budget {{vote:m5}}. It recommended ten-year extensions of public parking agreements with the school board and Grand River Hospital on King Street West {{vote:m4}}.

Other items were a three-year partnership agreement with the Stanley Park Community Association {{vote:m7}}, write-offs of uncollectable miscellaneous and utility accounts, and a noise exemption for a church's annual barbeque weekend. All recommendations go to Council for final adoption.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended Council join the Region's program with a 20-year exemption of the City's levy share for non-profit and co-operative housing providers from 2025, a staff report back after the first full year, and the amended draft by-law.
The committee recommended approving the Lodging House By-law, its fee schedule, and two full-time positions for administration, inspection and enforcement as part of the 2025 Budget.

The committee recommended ten-year extensions with the Waterloo Region District School Board for public parking at 787 and 828 King Street West, student and staff permits at 787, and with Grand River Hospital for 850 King Street West.
The committee recommended approving a three-year partnership agreement with the Stanley Park Community Association and authorizing staff to sign it and future renewals.
The committee recommended writing off $70,384 in uncollectable utility accounts against the allowance for doubtful utility receivables.
The committee recommended writing off $13,531 in uncollectable miscellaneous receivable accounts.
The committee recommended a noise exemption for the Holy Trinity Serbian Orthodox Church's Barbeque and Bull Roast on August 31 to September 1, 2024, between 11am and 10pm.
